requirement.text: At Start Up, the on board equipment shall perform an automatic self-test.

classification.rationale: The requirement describes an automatic startup self-test for train on-board equipment in an ERTMS/ETCS railway control system. This is an embedded/specialized control system, which does not fall under web, mobile, or AI system categories.

rounds.text_checked: At Start Up, the on board equipment shall perform an automatic self-test.

test_strategy.rationale: State-based testing applies because the requirement defines functional behavior triggered by a specific lifecycle state transition ('At Start Up'). Use case testing applies because performing a self-test at Start Up forms part of an end-to-end operational start-up sequence and has a direct dependency relationship with downstream requirements such as result display (PURE-ERTMS-R8).

test_cases.title: Automatic self-test execution upon transition to Start Up state
test_cases.preconditions: Onboard equipment is in the Powered Off state.
steps: Apply power to the onboard equipment to trigger the transition to the Start Up state.
Monitor system initialization state and internal self-test routine status.
test_cases.expected_result: The onboard equipment enters the Start Up state and automatically initiates and completes the internal self-test without requiring manual operator intervention.

test_cases.title: End-to-End Start Up sequence from power-on to self-test execution and result output
test_cases.preconditions: Onboard equipment is powered off and connected to the Driver Machine Interface (DMI).
steps: Initiate the start-up sequence by powering on the onboard equipment.
Observe the automatic execution of the self-test routines during the Start Up phase.
Verify that the system transitions from self-test completion to displaying the test outcome.
test_cases.expected_result: The onboard equipment executes the automatic self-test during Start Up, successfully making the self-test result available to be displayed on the DMI.

final_text: At Start Up, the on board equipment shall perform an automatic self-test.
